programs.title: Becoming Elephant: the Orphans of Reteti
programs.desc: Explore community-run Reteti Elephant Sanctuary, where human surrogate moms offer survival lessons and nurture young elephants through play. Bond with trunkless Long’uro and see why six-year-old Kelele’s mysterious illness could delay his release.

director: Andrew Ruhemann, Nick Southgate: Executive Producers

programs.title: Becoming Elephant: the Orphans of Reteti
programs.desc: Balance the pain of goodbyes with hope for the future as a generation of rescued elephants are finally released. Welcome new additions to the Reteti family, including a baby elephant rescued from a watering hole and a traumatized zebra named Kisima.

director: Andrew Ruhemann, Nick Southgate: Executive Producers

programs.title: Reef Wrecks
programs.desc: This island of the coast of Honduras stands out as a vacation resort hot spot. But it’s not just the sun and sand that brings the tourists in droves. It’s actually a diver’s paradise with shipwrecks scattered from all corners of the the island.

programs.title: The Living Beach
programs.desc: Get ready to understand the science behind Hawaii's stunning beaches. Why does sand appear white, yellow, black, green and red? How do active volcanoes change the coastline? Are other forces at play in shaping these incredible beaches.

programs.title: Ireland's Wild Islands
programs.desc: Endure winter and early spring on the west coast, where animals eke out a chilly existence. Watch red deer battle on windswept Inishvickillane, welcome seal pups amid howling storms on the Inishkea islands, and view the return of the basking sharks.

director: John Murray, Cepa Giblin: Producers, John Murray, Jamie Fitzpatrick: Directors

programs.title: The Ocean's Greatest Feast
programs.desc: Get a front-row seat to the planet’s biggest biomass migration, the annual 1,000-mile sardine run along South Africa’s east coast. See billions of these tiny fish run a gauntlet of hungry predators, including stealthy seals and dive-bombing gannets.

director: Mea Trenor: Writer, Producer; Graham McTavish: Narrator

programs.title: Shadowlands
programs.desc: Experience unbelievable acts of courage and loyalty by creatures trying to survive in the remote wilderness of New Zealand’s South Island. Face forest penguins’ feast and famine cycles, and explore the tumultuous world of newborn sea lions.

director: Judith Curran: Developed By, Lemuel Lyes: Senior Archive Producer

programs.title: Shadowlands
programs.desc: Learn how winter’s arrival triggers animal survival instincts in southwestern New Zealand. Track dolphins as they move to warmer waters to give their calves a fighting chance, and join longfin eels on an epic migration to their spawning grounds.

director: Judith Curran: Developed By, Lemuel Lyes: Senior Archive Producer
